scope: Independent offline audit of both completed CPU Release binary-step fine runs. Only this review JSON was created; no retained result, source, input, worker or Git state was modified.

provenance_audit.scope: All explicit links recursively recorded in the fine check/run/prepared records, plus the retained original CPU-run input bindings for transitive production source evidence. No old short-run native frames were reread for this audit.
provenance_audit.xml_comparison: Element-by-element comparison to the corresponding retained grad1 short XML found only four changed value attributes: DtIni, DtFixed, TimeMax and TimeOut. Other tags, text and attributes were identical.

native_audit.safety_method: Reread native frames using the retained original inspect() finite/positive-density/no-exclusion/elastic/precision/actual-load/drainage/mechanical-step/pore-step guard. The original guard was reused, not represented as an independently redesigned physical safety model.

ownership_audit: After completion, no process with recorded sequence/wrapper PIDs 51048, 60812, 49396 or reported monitor PID 96582 remained, and no CPU solver for cryer_grad_fine_r1 was found. No process was terminated by this review.
limitations: Only five saved samples over 0.48828125 ms were checked. This is not a complete startup waveform, peak-window, full-cycle or analytical Cryer acceptance.

The original decimal-step grad0 and grad1 short screens remain failed; their 0.125-ms output grid differs from the new 2^-13-s grid. No direct shifted-time, interpolated or pointwise old/new accuracy comparison is justified here.
The fine-pair pass does not by itself prove that the stress-rate correction improves theoretical accuracy, nor establish a temporal convergence order.
Density, pressure feedback, raw confinement, material, damping and geometry were not changed by this stage; no replacement coupled force operator was implemented.
Concurrent GPU diagnostics make recorded runtimes unsuitable as isolated performance benchmarks.
No GPU fine solver or other new run was launched by this audit.
